workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
ragged box text can break between '(' and a :ref; each edition's BOX 2.1 cites its figure where '(Fig. 2.2)' sits mid-line, checked by eye
ragged box text can set the punctuation after a bold run alone on the next line; every bold key term in a box is followed by a space, never by punctuation, and each edition's boxes are checked by eye
a no-break space is still a break opportunity, so '37 °C' could split; the BOX 2.1 sentence in each edition is worded so the temperature sits mid-line

a box's lists.color recolours its numbered lists only when it differs from unorderedLists.color (otherwise the numbers take orderedLists.color); the document's bullets are set in ink so every box keeps its own hue
config.locale does not localise Figure: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'es'): a region-tagged code such as 'es-ES' silently hyphenates as American English (gotcha hyphenation-locales)
borderRadius does not reach a side stripe (painted as its own square bar, unclipped), so only the unstriped warning is rounded and Method step 3 says why; revisit the step when fixed
